shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'charts|chartkit|theming|ThemeProvider|tokens|contrast' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,180p' src/main.tsx && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'semantic|base-background|base-generic|line-generic|text-secondary|ThemeProvider|whole page|root' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -160 && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json | head -50 && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts -path '*/docs/INDEX.md' -o -path '*/README.md' | head -10 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts | head -40 && rg -n '("'^| )Chart|type Chart|series|line|data:'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts 2>/dev/null | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/get-started.md && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md && rg -n -C 3 'ThemeProvider|root|whole page|semantic|--g-color|Typography|variant|Button view|flex|min-width' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120 && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-color-infographics-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | sort -u | head -60 && rg -n -C 3 'interface ChartProps|type ChartProps|ChartProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/App.css'
/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -type f -delete && find dist -depth -type d -empty -delete && git status --short'
